title: 1RB0RF_1LC1RE_0LD0LC_1RD0RB_1RA0RB_0LC---: halting needs a lost race, in Lean
text: An invariant of the macro map (valid word, at most one misaligned gap) is kept at every step except a lost race, an anomaly that comes while a misaligned gap is still pending. So the machine never halts unless some race is lost. The converse fails in simulation (some lost races halt, others go on), so this word-and-counter machine has a one-way reduction, not a halts-if-and-only-if one like the separator counter's.
